So look, we have -- we anticipate that in the near term, the next quarter, our costs would be impacted by anywhere between INR100 to INR 150 a ton, given our fuel mix and other things.
Growth & demand: Our sales volume increased by 8.8% over the last year.
On our share of volume, we can say that about 45% of our total volumes are dispatched through roads.
So 52% of our total trade volumes come from premium products, which is up by 9% on a year-on-year basis.
